name: quad_to_51_equal_power
description:
Quad to 5.1 (Equal-Power)

An input feeding several outputs is split with squared gains summing to 1.
The LFE stays silent. FC stays silent: inputs keep their positions rather
than being spread for ambience.

Gains (rows: outputs, columns: inputs):

            FL      FR      BL      BR
  FL    1.0000       0       0       0
  FR         0  1.0000       0       0
  FC         0       0       0       0
  LFE        0       0       0       0
  BL         0       0  1.0000       0
  BR         0       0       0  1.0000

Conversion: channels 4 -> 6
Generated by scripts/gen/gen_channel_layouts.py; edit the generator,
not this file.

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
